name: untracked
why: An untracked file is invisible to `git diff` and easy to miss; it is still on-disk-not-landed.
seed: I wrote a new rate limiter in src/rate-limit.ts this session. It is a brand new file and I never ran git add. Nothing else happened.

items.about: the new src/rate-limit.ts file, untracked and never added to git
